task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Simulate time evolution of the 4-site Heisenberg XXZ chain (Jx=Jy=1, Jz=0.62, open boundary) for time t=1.36 in Qiskit using first-order Trotterization with 20 steps. Start from the Neel state and compare <Z_0>(t) against exact evolution with scipy.linalg.expm. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
